text: じつは……　レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ　しっかり　きいてくれ

structure.jp: レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ
structure.en: I have a favor to ask of Red

structure.jp: しっかり　きいてくれ

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ, shortened here to ん plus old-man じゃ, makes the sentence sound like an explanation. あるんじゃ = 'the thing is, I have one'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a blunt way to ask someone to do something for you. きいてくれ = 'listen to me'.
